notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the death arc: corpse query, reclaim delay, resurrect request/response, spirit healer confirm/activate, reclaim corpse. MSUI implements CMSG_REPOP_REQUEST, CMSG_RECLAIM_CORPSE, CMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_ACTIVATE, CMSG_RESURRECT_RESPONSE (guid+accept byte) and handles SMSG_RESURRECT_REQUEST and SMSG_CORPSE_RECLAIM_DELAY.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: SMSG_DURABILITY_DAMAGE_DEATH is unmodelled in Benilla too (declared a later polish slice in death.rs), so its absence in MSUI is parity with the reference, not a regression.
